title: Adhesive Bonding of Metallic Secondary Structure — Surface Preparation and Cure Control

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Standard practice for adhesive bonding of metallic secondary structure, covering surface preparation, bond line thickness control, cure monitoring and the coupon evidence that must accompany a bonded repair.

sections.purpose: This standard practice gives the surface preparation, the bond line control and the cure monitoring that apply to every adhesive bond made on metallic secondary structure, and it defines the coupon evidence that must accompany the work.
sections.job_setup_note: Bonding is a controlled process and the environment governs the result. Record the ambient temperature and the relative humidity before you start and again at the end of the lay-up; a bond made outside the band in the instructions is not acceptable and cannot be recovered by extending the cure. Prepare the coupon at the same time as the joint, from the same batch, and cure it alongside the part.
sections.procedure: 1. Record the ambient temperature and the relative humidity and confirm that both are inside the band. 2. Mask the area to be bonded and protect the surrounding paint scheme. 3. Abrade the bonding surfaces to the finish given in the instructions and remove all loose material. CAUTION: DO NOT ABRADE THROUGH THE CLAD LAYER. WHERE THE CLAD LAYER IS BREACHED THE AREA MUST BE TREATED AND THE BOND LINE RE-ASSESSED. 4. Clean the surfaces with the approved solvent and confirm a continuous water break free surface. 5. Apply the surface treatment and let it dry for the stated period. 6. Verify the preparation using the process reference washer D2040116882018 and record the result. 7. Mix the adhesive by weight and record the batch number and the mix time. WARNING: THE ADHESIVE AND ITS HARDENER ARE SENSITISERS. WEAR GLOVES AND EYE PROTECTION AND WORK IN A VENTILATED AREA. 8. Apply the adhesive to both surfaces and set the bond line with the calibration bolt ZEDE604998-69 at the positions shown on drawing D20401217009. 9. Close the joint within the pot life and apply the clamping pressure given in the instructions. 10. Prepare the coupon from the same batch and place it beside the joint. 11. Monitor the cure temperature at three positions and record the full profile. 12. After cure, do a tap test of the bonded area and record any change in tone. 13. Test the coupon and attach the result to the work record.
sections.close_out: Remove the masking and restore the protection scheme around the bond. Record the environmental readings, the adhesive batch, the cure profile and the coupon result together; a bonded repair without this evidence is not acceptable. Report any cure profile excursion to engineering before the aircraft is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The low temperature cure system is available only where released for the repair scheme concerned.

safety_precautions: Wear gloves and eye protection when handling the adhesive and hardener.
Record the environment before and after the lay-up.
